Alex M.: quick shift snapshot — leaving a short checklist before I sign off in ~90m
Alex M.: Canary status: runtime v3.1 deployed to canary pool (1/3). basic traces look fine but 95p latency is ~20ms higher than baseline
Alex M.: Cache warm: prefix cache primed on us-west, still seeing cold hits for long prompts (~30s) on some hosts
Alex M.: Node oddity: two nodes in pool-2 reported low-memory warnings, K8s restarted the pods automatically — no evictions seen
Alex M.: Action items: @Sana R. please watch canary and error budget for next 2h, escalate if error rate > 0.5% or 5xx surge
Sana R.: ack, will keep an eye. kicking off a small eval against canary set now (100 reqs)
Miguel T.: pinging about PR #412 (batching backoff) — still needs one approver, left a comment about backoff floor
Miguel T.: I can take over if anything blocks the rollout after Alex signs off
Priya S.: on the mem warnings — grabbing logs now. running `kubectl logs -n runtime --since=1h | grep -i oom` and checking GC spikes
oncall-bot: runtime v3.1 canary deployed by deploy-bot at 2025-06-12T18:04:12Z
Sana R.: eval run results: no quality regressions, p95 latency matches trace, but embeddings backend had a small token latency spike on host ip-10-2-7-4
Priya S.: found noisy GC cycles on ip-10-2-7-4 around 17:50 PT, filing ticket INF-879 and tagging team
Alex M.: timeline: if no issues in next 2h we plan gradual rollout. Miguel to merge PR #412 after you finish review. Sana to confirm canary metrics at +30m and +90m
Miguel T.: will finish review in next 20m, then ping for merge
Sana R.: noted — I'll post a short metrics snapshot at +30m here (latency, errors, qps)
Priya S.: I'll monitor node restarts. if we see >1 restart in 30m I'll escalate to oncall pager and open a bridge
Alex M.: handover: I'm offline at 20:30 PT. Miguel covers until 21:30 PT. Priya will own node monitoring overnight
Miguel T.: covering 20:30–21:30 PT. ping `@Miguel T.` for handoff questions
Sana R.: thanks team. small ask: if you see any new 5xx please include the request id in logs (example: `req=abcd1234`)
Alex M.: end
